name: Explainer build
oneLiner: a glass card assembles on the speaker's cues: the blank card, the title, then 3 to 5 glyph blocks scale in one by one, an accent outline draws around a group and names it, and at the end one block lifts toward camera while the rest dim
say: when the speaker breaks something into its parts ("an AI agent is made of four things..."): set cues to the seconds each part is named so every block lands on its word; the outline lands on the word that groups them, the lift on the one that matters most. layout top keeps it above the speaker
